instruction: Pick up the key, hand it over to the other hand, insert it into the keyhole, then turn it.

arguments.note: The key lies flat to the right of the lock. I turn the right gripper downward to approach its bow.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 31 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I move above the key, completing the downward orientation while still clear of the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 22 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The wrist view shows the key bow slightly right of center. I descend to just above it for a precise final alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The bow is centered between the jaws laterally. I lower to the flat-key grasp height before closing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The head view shows the bow still nearer the front than the jaws. I shift toward it at table height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The bow remains just forward of the jaw centers. I align the grasp with the round bow rather than the blade.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The bow is between the jaws. I make a final five-millimetre adjustment and close around it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws have closed onto the bow. I lift the key clear of the table for the handover.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The key is lifted. I begin tipping its blade downward and aligning it for an upright handover.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The combined rotation was refused. I first align the blade with the world y direction.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I tip the blade downward in a smaller orientation step, keeping the key well above the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The key slipped during the wrist rotation and is back on the table. I prepare the left hand to recover it and move the right wrist away from its limiting orientation.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: I turn only the left hand downward to recover the key, avoiding a coupled plan with the right arm.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 31 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The key bow is now near the table center. I bring the left gripper above it for recovery.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 35 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The previous motion stopped early. I continue toward the key bow with the left hand.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The arms are interfering near the center. I withdraw the empty right hand to clear the left hand's approach.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: With the right arm clear, I lower the left gripper above the bow.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The bow is slightly right of the left gripper center and tilted on its edge. I make a small correction and grasp it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I lift the recovered key and bring it toward the lock with clearance for reorientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The recovered key has settled with its blade forward. I tip it down in a controlled intermediate rotation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.hindsight: I should have transferred the key to an opposing grasp before rotating it, moved the idle arm clear earlier, and used smaller rotations while checking grip retention.
arguments.reason: The key was lifted, but it slipped during both reorientation attempts. I could not complete the handover or insertion with the remaining motion budget.

calls.tool_result: Acknowledged give_up.

arguments.hindsight: I should have transferred the key to an opposing grasp before rotating it, moved the idle arm clear earlier, and used smaller rotations while checking grip retention.
arguments.reason: The key was lifted, but it slipped during both reorientation attempts. I could not complete the handover or insertion with the remaining motion budget.
